readme.text:
An unofficial [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek.com) port of the
[Elephant-Goldfish Model](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model) (EGM): design with an
Elephant, review with fresh-context Goldfish.

The bundle provides the seven EGM skills, the nine upstream reviewer personas, the five document
standards, and DSH Agent Presets that enforce the reviewer tool restrictions. It is generated from a
pinned upstream commit and tracks upstream automatically.

> EGM is a Google project. This is an unofficial port, not affiliated with or endorsed by Google,
> and not an officially supported Google product. EGM content is Apache-2.0.

Ask the agent in a Creator-mode session:

```text
Install the DeepSeek Harness bundle github:uzair-suria/dsh-egm
```

or use the **Plugins** page's bundle install action with the same spec. Enable the bundle, restart or
reload DSH, and start a new session. For a pinned release, use
`github:uzair-suria/dsh-egm#v0.1.1`.

Local development can link the checkout:

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle target="link:C:\Users\uzair\Desktop\dsh-egm"
```

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `/egm-brainstorm` | Turn a rough concept into `concepts_brief.md` with fresh reviewer lenses. |
| `/egm-draft` | Draft `design_draft.md` section by section. |
| `/egm-review <draft>` | Run the five-stage Goldfish review. |
| `/egm-review-loop` | Run a configured reviewer group directly. |
| `/egm-resolve` | Resolve findings with accept/contest/escalate decisions. |
| `/egm-bootstrap` | Write or correct EGM-compliant README contracts across a tree. |
| `/egm-drift-report` | Compare checked-in documents with the current code. |
Start a new session after installation; DSH caches the `/` catalog per session.

readme.section: Reviewers are presets with restricted tools
readme.text: EGM reviewers are DSH **Agent Presets** selected by `egm_subagent` through `agent_preset`:

readme.section: Reviewers are presets with restricted tools
readme.text:
| Preset | Tools |
| --- | --- |
| `egm-design`, `egm-structural`, `egm-style`, `egm-comprehension`, `egm-implementation-readiness`, `egm-codebase-details`, `egm-zoom-out`, `egm-reviewer` | `read`, `read_image`, `grep`, `glob` |
| `egm-synthesizer` | `read`, `read_image`, `grep`, `glob`, `write`, `egm_subagent` |
| `egm-bootstrap-orchestrator` | read, grep, glob, write, edit, shell, `egm_subagent` |
| `egm-goldfish-explorer` | `read`, `read_image`, `grep`, `glob` |

readme.section: Reviewers are presets with restricted tools
readme.text:
The reviewer presets have **no write, edit, shell, or delegation tool**, and they do not load
`AGENTS.md`. A preset-level `dsh-egm/tool-guard` plugin denies the inherited global surface:
`egm_subagent`, workspace helpers, and every GitHub MCP function. On a Host with MCP resource
servers, the read-only MCP resource primitives may remain outside the declared function schema.
The restriction is enforced by the tool composition, not by prompt wording.

readme.section: Reviewers are presets with restricted tools
readme.text:
`egm_subagent` passes a delegation depth cap of 2, so the synthesizer and bootstrap workers can spawn
their children without changing the Host depth setting. The general `subagent` tool remains for
non-EGM work.

- [Port guide](docs/PORT.md) — install, invocation, presets, read-only, depth, concurrency,
  artifacts, update, troubleshooting.
- [DSH integration](docs/DSH.md) — the host adapter copied into every skill bundle.
- [Design](docs/DESIGN.md) — the implementation contract.
- [Differences](docs/DIFFERENCES.md) — every intentional change from upstream.
- [Upstream sync](docs/UPSTREAM-SYNC.md) — the converter and CI workflow.
- [Live smoke test](docs/SMOKE-TEST.md) — the post-install acceptance checklist.
- [Docs index](docs/README.md).

`src/convert.mjs` clones the upstream repository at the pinned SHA and produces `skills/`,
`skills.json`, and `docs/upstream/`. The seven bundles are self-contained: each carries the ten
personas, the five standards, the shared resources, its references, its icon, and `DSH.md`. The
converter transforms only four sites in `SKILL.md` and one docs link; validation reverses them and
compares every file to upstream.

`cordis.patch.yml` is generated from `src/presets.mjs` and declares the skill provider and the
eleven Agent Presets. `lib/index.js` serves the seven skills; `lib/subagent.mjs` is the custom
`egm_subagent` tool that selects an EGM preset at call time.

The repository is also the bundle package; `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`.

Updates are explicit through the plugin manager or the Plugins page. Installed bundles do not
silently auto-update. Removing the **EGM** bundle removes the skills, presets, and
`egm_subagent`; no files are written to a user skill root.
